summary: Iteration 4 end-to-end verification of Staff PIN login + role-based access + detail-page editing + change tracking. All backend endpoints (17/17) and all frontend flows PASS.

tests_executed.name: POST /api/auth/staff-login PIN=1234
tests_executed.details: Returns access_token + user{role:'staff', name:'Warehouse Staff'}. PIN 0000 → 401.

tests_executed.name: Role enforcement - admin-only endpoints reject staff
tests_executed.details: Staff token 403s on GET /api/staff, POST /api/suppliers, POST /api/statuses, GET/DELETE /api/archive.

tests_executed.name: Staff POST /api/receivals
tests_executed.details: Creates record with receivedBy='Warehouse Staff' from JWT, changeLog[0].action='Created receival record'. No PIN in payload required.

tests_executed.name: Staff PUT /api/receivals/{id} restriction
tests_executed.details: supplierId → 403; recordedInSystem → 403; palletCount/observation/items → 200 and appended changeLog entry with by='Warehouse Staff', role='staff', changes dict.

tests_executed.name: Staff POST /api/receivals/{id}/media add + remove
tests_executed.details: Added photo & signature (images/signatures length increased), removed one photo, changeLog updated with 'Updated media: added ..., removed ...'.

tests_executed.name: Admin PUT supplierId + recordedInSystem
tests_executed.details: Admin change succeeds and changeLog entry with role='admin' recorded.

tests_executed.name: UI: Staff login on /login
tests_executed.details: tab-staff-login → staff-pin=1234 → staff-login-submit → landed on list. current-user badge shows 'Warehouse Staff STAFF'.

tests_executed.name: UI: Role-based nav
tests_executed.details: As staff: nav-settings and nav-settings-mobile are absent; /settings redirects to /. As admin: nav-settings visible and /settings loads.

tests_executed.name: UI: Staff /new page
tests_executed.details: No PIN field. received-by box shows 'Warehouse Staff STAFF'. supplier-combobox works (4 opts), pallet-count=4, submit-receival → redirect to list; row created with Received by 'Warehouse Staff'.

tests_executed.name: UI: Staff receival list restrictions
tests_executed.details: For each row: supplier-name-<id> present (text), NO supplier-dropdown-<id>, NO edit-<id>, NO delete-<id>, only view-<id> present.

tests_executed.name: UI: Admin receival list controls
tests_executed.details: supplier-dropdown-<id>, edit-<id>, delete-<id> all present; checklist Switch toggles visible.

tests_executed.name: UI: Staff detail edit + change history
tests_executed.details: edit-detail-btn → edit-pallet-input=11 → edit-add-item + edit-item-desc-0='TEST_UI_item' → drew signature-canvas + edit-signed-by='UI Tester' + edit-add-signature → save-edit-btn. After reload change-history card contains: 'Edited record — Warehouse Staff (staff) — pallet count: 4 → 11, items: updated items' followed by 'Created receival record — Warehouse Staff (staff)'. Pallet value '11' and item 'TEST_UI_item' persisted.

critical_code_review_comments: In server.py:save_base64_image, uploads to the external object-storage service occasionally 500 under parallel load (observed when pytest-xdist ran the media tests concurrently — same 1x1 PNG succeeds when serial). Not a code bug in this app but worth a retry-with-backoff around put_object to make it robust against transient upstream 500s.
The legacy /api/verify-pin endpoint is still exposed with no auth requirement — since staff-login now covers this, verify-pin could be deprecated or made admin-only to reduce surface (minor).

In update_receival's changeLog diff for 'items', payload is a list of Pydantic models converted implicitly; the diff records only 'updated items' rather than the actual delta, which is fine but could be enriched later with old→new for auditability.
test_credentials: Admin admin@eurasia.com/admin123 and Staff PIN 1234 both work as documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: Created one staff-created receival during UI test (id printed in logs); cleaned up via admin delete at end of run. Also transient TEST_ receivals in backend tests are deleted in fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite MUST be run with -n 0 (serial) or the object-storage service returns transient 500s on concurrent uploads. Suppliers combobox testid on /new is 'supplier-combobox' (not 'supplier-select' which is used on Settings). change-history card is only rendered when changeLog is non-empty. Staff role badge is rendered as an uppercased span next to the name inside data-testid=current-user.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Initial pytest failures on receival-create-with-images were caused by pytest-xdist running media-heavy tests in parallel and hitting a transient 500 from the upstream object-storage service; re-running serially yielded 17/17 pass.
